name: relu_eq_self_of_nonneg
stmt: lemma relu_eq_self_of_nonneg (x : ℝ) (h : 0 ≤ x) : relu x = x
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact max_eq_left h

name: relu_eq_zero_of_nonpos
stmt: lemma relu_eq_zero_of_nonpos (x : ℝ) (h : x ≤ 0) : relu x = 0
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact max_eq_right h

name: relu_sq_local
stmt: lemma relu_sq_local (a y : ℝ) (h : a < y) : relu (y - a) = y - a

name: deriv_relu_sq_gt
stmt:
lemma deriv_relu_sq_gt (a x : ℝ) (h : a < x) :
    deriv (fun y => relu (y - a) ^ 2) x = 2 * (x - a)
proof:
by
                               
  have hloc : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, relu (y - a) = y - a := by
                             
    have hmem : x ∈ Set.Ioi a := h
    exact mem_of_superset (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hmem) (fun y hy => relu_sq_local a y hy)
                             
  have hder : HasDerivAt (fun y => relu (y - a) ^ 2) (2 * (x - a)) x := by
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y - a) 1 x := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).sub (hasDerivAt_const x a)
    have hpow : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y - a) ^ 2) (2 * (x - a)) x := by
      simpa using hlin.pow 2
                                     
    refine hpow.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hloc] with y hy
    rw [hy]
  exact hder.deriv

name: P2a_nonstationary_when_unsatisfied
stmt:
theorem P2a_nonstationary_when_unsatisfied (a x : ℝ) (h : a < x) :
    deriv (fun y => relu (y - a) ^ 2) x ≠ 0
proof:
by
  rw [deriv_relu_sq_gt a x h]
  have hx : x - a ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h2 : 2 * (x - a) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hx ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0))
  exact h2

name: relu_add_complement_const
stmt:
lemma relu_add_complement_const (y : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < y) (h1 : y < 1) :
    relu y + relu (1 - y) = 1
proof:
by
  have hy : relu y = y := relu_eq_self_of_nonneg y (le_of_lt h0)
  have h1y : relu (1 - y) = 1 - y := relu_eq_self_of_nonneg (1 - y) (by linarith)
  rw [hy, h1y]
  ring

name: ReLUSumLoss_const_on_open
stmt:
lemma ReLUSumLoss_const_on_open (x : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < x) (h1 : x < 1) :
    deriv ReLUSumLoss x = 0
proof:
by
                              
  have hloc : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ReLUSumLoss y = 1 := by
    have hmem : x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨h0, h1⟩
    exact mem_of_superset (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hmem) (fun y hy =>
      congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z) (relu_add_complement_const y hy.1 hy.2))
  have hc : HasDerivAt ReLUSumLoss 0 x := by
    apply (hasDerivAt_const x (1 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    simpa [ReLUSumLoss] using hloc
  exact hc.deriv

name: P2b_false_stationarity
stmt:
theorem P2b_false_stationarity :
    ∃ x : ℝ, 0 < x ∧ x < 1 ∧ deriv ReLUSumLoss x = 0 ∧ ¬(x ≤ 0 ∧ 1 - x ≤ 0)
proof:
by
  refine ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ReLUSumLoss_const_on_open (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  · norm_num

name: P2a_relu_sq_summary
stmt:
theorem P2a_relu_sq_summary (a x : ℝ) :
    a < x → deriv (fun y => relu (y - a) ^ 2) x ≠ 0

name: Residual
stmt: def Residual (F : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) : E
proof:
x + F x

                 
                                                

omit [NormedSpace ℝ E] in

name: residual_error_isolation
stmt:
theorem residual_error_isolation (x Fx Gx : E) :
    ‖(x + Fx) - (x + Gx)‖ = ‖Fx - Gx‖
proof:
by
  have h : (x + Fx) - (x + Gx) = Fx - Gx := by
    abel
  rw [h]

name: residual_edit_local
stmt:
theorem residual_edit_local (x : E) (F F' : E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ‖Residual F' x - Residual F x‖ ≤ ‖F' - F‖ * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  unfold Residual
                                    
  have h : (x + F' x) - (x + F x) = F' x - F x := by
    abel
  rw [h]
  exact edit_output_bound F F' x

name: residual_edit_constraint
stmt:
theorem residual_edit_constraint (W : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ℝ) (x : E) (F F' : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (h : W (Residual F x) + b = 0) :
    |W (Residual F' x) + b| ≤ ‖W‖ * (‖F' - F‖ * ‖x‖)
proof:
by
                                                         
  have hzero : |W (Residual F' x) + b| = |W (Residual F' x) + b - (W (Residual F x) + b)| := by
    rw [h]
    ring
  have hlin : W (Residual F' x) + b - (W (Residual F x) + b) = W (Residual F' x - Residual F x) := by
                                    
    calc
      W (Residual F' x) + b - (W (Residual F x) + b) = W (Residual F' x) - W (Residual F x) := by ring
      _ = W (Residual F' x - Residual F x) := (W.map_sub (Residual F' x) (Residual F x)).symm
  calc
    |W (Residual F' x) + b| = |W (Residual F' x) + b - (W (Residual F x) + b)| := hzero
    _ = |W (Residual F' x - Residual F x)| := by rw [hlin]
    _ ≤ ‖W‖ * ‖Residual F' x - Residual F x‖ := W.le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖W‖ * (‖F' - F‖ * ‖x‖) := by
      have hb : ‖Residual F' x - Residual F x‖ ≤ ‖F' - F‖ * ‖x‖ := residual_edit_local x F F'
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (norm_nonneg W)

name: residual_two_layer_isolation_exact
stmt:
theorem residual_two_layer_isolation_exact (x : E) (F₁ F₂ G₁ G₂ : E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ‖Residual F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - Residual G₂ (Residual G₁ x)‖ ≤
      (‖F₂‖ + 1) * ‖Residual F₁ x - Residual G₁ x‖ + ‖F₂ - G₂‖ * ‖Residual G₁ x‖
proof:
by
                                                                   
  calc
    ‖Residual F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - Residual G₂ (Residual G₁ x)‖
        ≤ ‖Residual F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - Residual F₂ (Residual G₁ x)‖
          + ‖Residual F₂ (Residual G₁ x) - Residual G₂ (Residual G₁ x)‖ := by
            have h : Residual F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - Residual G₂ (Residual G₁ x) =
                (Residual F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - Residual F₂ (Residual G₁ x))
                + (Residual F₂ (Residual G₁ x) - Residual G₂ (Residual G₁ x)) := by abel
            rw [h]
            exact norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖F₂‖ + 1) * ‖Residual F₁ x - Residual G₁ x‖ + ‖F₂ - G₂‖ * ‖Residual G₁ x‖ := by
                                                                               
      have h1 : ‖Residual F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - Residual F₂ (Residual G₁ x)‖ ≤
          (‖F₂‖ + 1) * ‖Residual F₁ x - Residual G₁ x‖ := by
                                                                
        calc
          ‖Residual F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - Residual F₂ (Residual G₁ x)‖
              = ‖(Residual F₁ x + F₂ (Residual F₁ x)) - (Residual G₁ x + F₂ (Residual G₁ x))‖ := rfl
          _ = ‖(Residual F₁ x - Residual G₁ x) + (F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - F₂ (Residual G₁ x))‖ := by
                have h : (Residual F₁ x + F₂ (Residual F₁ x)) - (Residual G₁ x + F₂ (Residual G₁ x)) =
                    (Residual F₁ x - Residual G₁ x) + (F₂ (Residual F₁ x) - F₂ (Residual G₁ x)) := by abel
                rw [h]
          _ ≤ ‖Residual
